name: Google Calendar
category_description: App node - connects to an external service API
description: Use the Google Calendar node to automate work in Google Calendar, and integrate Google Calendar with other applications. n8n has built-in support for a wide range of Google Calendar features, including adding, retrieving, deleting and updating calendar events

operations.description: If a time-slot is available in a calendar

parameters.name: Credential to connect with
parameters.description: Create or select an existing Google Calendar credentials

parameters.name: Resource
parameters.description: Select Calendar

parameters.name: Operation
parameters.description: Select Availability

parameters.name: Calendar
parameters.description: Choose a calendar you want to check against. Select From list to choose the title from the dropdown list or By ID to enter a calendar ID

parameters.name: Start Time
parameters.description: The start time for the time-slot you want to check. By default, uses an expression evaluating to the current time ({{ $now }})

parameters.name: End Time
parameters.description: The end time for the time-slot you want to check. By default, uses an expression evaluating to an hour from now ({{ $now.plus(1, 'hour') }})

options.name: Output Format
options.description: Select the format for the availability information:

options.name: Timezone
options.description: The timezone used in the response. By default, uses the n8n timezone

operations.description: Retrieve all events from a calendar

parameters.name: Credential to connect with
parameters.description: Create or select an existing Google Calendar credentials

parameters.name: Resource
parameters.description: Select Event

parameters.name: Operation
parameters.description: Select Get Many

parameters.name: Calendar
parameters.description: Choose a calendar you want to get an event from. Select From list to choose the title from the dropdown list or By ID to enter a calendar ID

parameters.name: Return All
parameters.description: Whether to return all results or only up to a given limit

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: (When "Return All" isn't selected) The maximum number of results to return

parameters.name: After
parameters.description: Retrieve events that occur after this time. At least part of the event must be after this time. By default, this uses an expression evaluating to the current time ({{ $now }}). Switch the field to "fixed" to select a date from a date widget

parameters.name: Before
parameters.description: Retrieve events that occur before this time. At least part of the event must be before this time. By default, this uses an expression evaluating to the current time plus a week ({{ $now.plus({ week: 1 }) }}). Switch the field to "fixed" to select a date from a date widget

options.name: Fields
options.description: Specify the fields to return. By default, returns a set of commonly used fields predefined by Google. Use "\*" to return all fields. You can find out more in Google Calendar's documentation on working with partial resources

options.name: iCalUID
options.description: Specifies an event ID (in the iCalendar format) to include in the response

options.name: Max Attendees
options.description: The maximum number of attendees to include in the response. If there are more than the specified number of attendees, only returns the participant

options.name: Order By
options.description: The order to use for the events in the response

options.name: Query
options.description: Free text search terms to find events that match. This searches all fields except for extended properties

options.name: Recurring Event Handling
options.description: What to do for recurring events:

options.name: Show Deleted
options.description: Whether to include deleted events (with status equal to "cancelled") in the results

options.name: Show Hidden Invitations
options.description: Whether to include hidden invitations in the results

options.name: Timezone
options.description: The timezone used in the response. By default, uses the n8n timezone

options.name: Updated Min
options.description: The lower bounds for an event's last modification time (as an RFC 3339 timestamp)
